about: Hitpoints of raid NPCs by party size, 1 to 8 players. From the OSRS Wiki's pages for each NPC (read 2026-11-01). The Fractured Archive page says every boss scales to the players in the raid, with a player alone counted as two, which the Wiki's tables agree with (1 and 2 players the same). No formula is given, so each NPC lists all eight.
